summary: Iteration 31 e2e testing of 3 new features (SYNC-ZEITSTEMPEL, EXPORT-VERLAUF, PAPIERKORB) on web preview could NOT be executed end-to-end because the preview environment has 0 persisted projects (iteration-30 projects like 'Frisch (Import)' are not present – likely different storage snapshot). Creating a new project via the UI requires a multi-step flow (project form -> navigate to /customers?selectMode=true -> create customer -> return) that my automated run could not complete reliably within the limited interactions. The disclaimer flow (scroll + checkbox + accept) works. Home screen renders. Code review of the 5 reference files confirms the implementations look sound and consistent with the spec. Deprecated packages detected: expo-media-library/legacy and expo-file-system/legacy are imported in projects/[id].tsx (also expected per existing codebase patterns, but worth noting). Dialogs for duplicate/import, 'Zuletzt exportiert' label, trash restore/delete testIDs are all wired in the code. Main agent should seed at least one project (or main agent/user can run the flow manually) before re-triggering this testing phase so the e2e flow can be captured in Playwright.

integration_issues.flow: Automated e2e unable to seed project
integration_issues.issue: Creating a project via UI requires selecting a customer, which navigates away to /customers?selectMode=true. The screen shows '0 Kunden' and a + button. The customer-create modal uses an uncaptioned 'Save' button that the generic text-match heuristic did not hit. e2e flow of Export/Trash was therefore not exercised. No bug in app logic - purely a seeding problem for the test harness in a fresh preview env.

react_native_issues.issue: Legacy imports still used: import * as FileSystem from 'expo-file-system/legacy'; writeAsStringAsync/readAsStringAsync/copyAsync/deleteAsync via legacy API. Reference: /app/frontend/app/projects/[id].tsx:38-39, /app/frontend/utils/projectTransfer.ts:18. Not a regression for THIS iteration but should be migrated to the new File API when feasible.
Legacy import: import * as MediaLibrary from 'expo-media-library/legacy'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/projects/[id].tsx:47. Pre-existing; not touched by this iteration.

action_items: Seed at least ONE project (and customer) in the preview environment OR provide a seed script, so this iteration's three flows can be verified end-to-end by the next testing pass. Previous iteration 30 projects (e.g. 'Frisch (Import)') are missing from this preview URL.
Consider adding a testID='create-customer-save' on the customer-create submit button and 'create-project-save' on the project-create submit button to make e2e seeding reliable from Playwright.

After seeding, re-run testing to confirm: (TEST1) 'Zuletzt exportiert: <dd.mm.yyyy>, <hh:mm> Uhr' is shown and persisted; (TEST2) duplicate window.confirm message contains '📄 Datei exportiert:' + '📱 Gerät zuletzt geändert:' + newer-hint line; (TEST3) replaced project appears in /trash with 'noch 30 Tage' badge and 'Gelöscht:' line; (TEST4) trash-restore-<id> moves project back to Home; (TEST5) trash-delete-<id> is Alert.alert gated (known web-blocked) – main agent should verify in native build.

Code review: implementations in projectTransfer.ts (DuplicateInfo with fileExportedAt/deviceChangedAt, moveToTrash on update, setLastExported after export, stripSystemFields now strips last_exported_at and deleted_at) and trash.tsx (purgeExpiredTrash on load, testIDs on buttons, 'noch N Tage' + 'läuft heute ab' badges, Alert.alert for destructive confirm) look correct and consistent with the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: utils/projectTransfer.ts: on web, askDuplicateAction uses window.confirm with a message that correctly includes '📄 Datei exportiert:', '📱 Gerät zuletzt geändert:' and one of the three newer-hint lines ('praktisch gleich aktuell', 'Datei ist NEUER', or 'Stand auf DIESEM GERÄT ist neuer'). ✅ matches spec.

trash.tsx: Alert.alert used for restore success and delete-forever confirm. On react-native-web Alert.alert does not render, so TEST5 (endgültig löschen) will silently no-op from Playwright – this is a known RN-web limitation, NOT a bug. The restore flow calls ProjectService.restoreFromTrash() BEFORE showing the Alert, so TEST4 still works even without an interactive alert.

projects/[id].tsx: 'Zuletzt exportiert' label gated on Features.showProjektExport && project.last_exported_at. After successful export, setProject() is updated optimistically before the loadProjectData call, so label should appear immediately. ✅

LocalStorage.ts (not shown here but referenced): ensure getAll filters by deleted_at so trashed items do not re-appear on Home; getTrashed returns only items with deleted_at; purgeExpiredTrash deletes items older than 30 days. Please verify with a quick unit snippet after seeding.
projectTransfer.ts stripSystemFields correctly deletes last_exported_at and deleted_at so imported copies start fresh.

success_rate.frontend: 0% executed e2e – blocked on empty preview DB (code review passed)

seed_data_creation: Attempted to create TEST_Projekt_31 via UI; blocked because customer-create flow is multi-screen and lacks a stable testID on the save button. Nothing new was persisted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The preview URL (https://image-render-test.preview.emergentagent.com) currently has ZERO projects. Before running Playwright for iteration 31's three features, you must either: (a) manually create a project and customer first via the UI (New Project -> Kunde auswählen -> + -> fill name -> Save -> back to form -> Save), or (b) ask main agent to add testID attributes on the customer-save and project-save buttons for scripted seeding, or (c) use a localStorage/IndexedDB seed script. All critical testIDs for the actual feature flows (home-import, project-export, settings-trash, trash-restore-<id>, trash-delete-<id>) exist in code and are reachable once at least one project exists. The duplicate dialog on web uses window.confirm with a message containing both timestamps and the newer-hint line; register page.on('dialog') BEFORE clicking home-import. Alert.alert does NOT render on react-native-web so TEST5 (endgültig löschen) can only be verified via code review or native build – this is a KNOWN WEB LIMITATION already acknowledged in the request.
rca_of_issue: Not a bug - test environment issue. Preview env ran purgeExpiredTrash and/or had a cleared AsyncStorage, leaving 0 projects. Feature code is implemented correctly per code review but could not be exercised end-to-end from fresh state without a successful project-create seed.
